# v4.20i

> v4.20i is a Nuxt starter template with English, Spanish and Portuguese support, by Eco Development Studios.

The public demo has a home page with a name input and an About page, along with language and theme controls. It demonstrates locale-aware navigation and translated interface text.

## Public pages

- [Home in English](https://v420i.ecostudios.dev/)
- [About in English](https://v420i.ecostudios.dev/about)
- [Inicio en español](https://v420i.ecostudios.dev/es)
- [Acerca de en español](https://v420i.ecostudios.dev/es/about)
- [Início em português](https://v420i.ecostudios.dev/pt)
- [Sobre em português](https://v420i.ecostudios.dev/pt/about)
- [Sitemap](https://v420i.ecostudios.dev/sitemap.xml)

## Publisher

- [Eco Development Studios](https://www.ecostudios.dev/)
